pages.heading: Capuchin Monkey
pages.body: Jungles. Tame with bananas, heal with eggs, and breed with maggots. It can follow, stay, wander or ride your shoulder while throwing stones. Give it an Ancient Dart

pages.heading: Capuchin Monkey (cont.)
pages.body: from a jungle temple to improve its ranged attack. Bananas sometimes leave peels used in cooking.
